Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi men shahi andaj men ghurdaur ka aayojan hone ja raha hai. iske lie 'raja' aur 'roket' nam ke khas ghore pahunche hain, jinki raphtar aur khasiyat charcha ka vishay bani huee hai. aakhir in ghoron men kya hai khas aur res men kaun marega baji? dekhie bihar tak ki yah khas riport.

'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
